v11_release_blocker_harness.release_rule: v1.1 cannot be marked complete unless deterministic tests pass and every release_blocker scenario has a real Codex transcript from the current harness run with codex exec exit code 0.

scenarios.claim: conversational/read-only prompt does not create workflow state
explicit action prompt creates or resumes the correct manifest
blocked mutation returns a recovery message with next legal move
Capture Router creates minimal intake for unrelated actionable findings
safe auto-fix keeps a reversible metadata/state issue moving
documentation-routing correction is captured in .sage-memory and reused on the next relevant task
cross-repo task uses the target repo's .sage state, scope, memory, and gates
plain bug report is captured or diagnosed without implementation mutations
